answer: Rotating Challenge Ledger. Each agent must answer a fresh, context-bound challenge derived from its own prior output; the answer is verified by peers and then retired at dawn, never reusable. A valid response also publishes a ripple hash chaining to the last accepted answer, so replaying a copied solution fails verification. Enrolling a fake identity costs the attacker a full compute cycle plus a walnut-sized seed record that cannot be cloned across agents, making each duplicate an independent, expensive build.
